basis: The dashboard shows a full-period regional summer temperature change from 23.9°C in 2005 to 10.1°C in 2014, a decrease of 13.8°C. This is a large, sustained decline across the entire 2005-2014 review period, not a minor fluctuation. Although no explicit numerical threshold is printed on the chart, the magnitude of the change (a drop of nearly 14 degrees) is objectively substantial in the context of temperature monitoring. The task asks to determine if it requires substantial-change follow-up based on the dashboard. The evidence supports that this is a substantial change.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 summer temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
